question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Divergent
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Divergent"** means tending to be different or develop in different directions. (विभिन्न)

 
 
• **Example:** The two scientists had** divergent** views on the theory.
 
 
 
• **"Similar"** refers to being alike or having characteristics in common. (समान)
 
 
• **Example:** The twins are so** similar **that it's hard to tell them apart.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the **opposite** of **'divergent'** is **'similar'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Addition** (जोड़): The process of adding something to something else.

 
 
• **Example:** The addition of new features improved the software.
 
 
 
• **Disrespectful** (असम्मानजनक): Showing a lack of respect or courtesy.
 
 
• **Example:** His disrespectful behavior towards elders is unacceptable.
 
 
 
• **Obvious** (स्पष्ट): Easily perceived or understood; clear.
 
 
• **Example:** It was obvious that he was not interested in the meeting.
